Puerto Vallarta — Dad’s 80th Birthday

Nuevo Vallarta / Bucerías

Walking here is the beach itself — long, flat sand. No town malecón.

Marival Emotions Resort & Suites

$$

≈12 km · ~25 min from the airport

3 pickleball courts with equipment included, shuffleboard, 6 pools, 7 restaurants, beachfront, about 20 minutes from the airport. Big lively family resort.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 54% off, or a free 5th night on 5+ night suite stays. April dates are covered. Book by Thu Nov 26.

Visit resort →

Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit

$$$$$

≈12 km · ~20 min from the airport

4 pickleball courts, best food of the bunch, all suites with big terraces, beachfront, about 20 minutes from the airport. Upscale and quiet. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Black Friday: 20% off Grand Class and Family suites, plus spa and golf perks. Book by Thu Dec 3. April dates look clear — confirm at booking.

Visit resort →

Paradise Village Beach Resort and Spa

$

≈12 km · ~20 min from the airport

Pickleball at the on-site El Tigre racquet club, shuffleboard, 900 ft of beach, next to the marina and shops so the best walking of the Nuevo resorts. All-suite, condo-style. (Room-only rate shown; all-inclusive is an add-on.)

Current promotion: Stay Longer, Save More: 35% off the all-inclusive plan on 7+ night stays. Book by Sun Dec 20.

Visit resort →

Marival Distinct All-Suites & World Spa

$$$$

≈13 km · ~30 min from the airport

1 pickleball court (reservation only), spa-focused, quieter and more grown-up feel than its sister resort next door. Shuffleboard is at the sister resort, a short walk away.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 54% off penthouses, villas and Premier suites, or a free 5th night on 5+ night stays. April dates are covered. Book by Thu Nov 26.

Visit resort →

Occidental Nuevo Vallarta

$$

≈11 km · ~20 min from the airport

Pickleball on one outdoor court with equipment on site, plus shuffleboard — beachfront all-inclusive family resort in Nuevo Vallarta, next door to the Hard Rock (confirm the court’s exact spot on the grounds at booking).

Current promotion: Black Friday: extra 15% off with code 26BF15. Book by Sun Nov 29; travel through Jun 30 — April is covered.

Visit resort →

Grand Decameron Complex Bucerías

$

≈17 km · ~20 min from the airport

Big, lively, budget all-inclusive right in Bucerías town — five pools, eight restaurants and a long beach, with one dedicated pickleball court. Great value, but expect a bustling mega-resort, not a quiet retreat.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 50% off selected stays. Book by Thu Dec 3.

Visit resort →

Villa La Estancia Beach Resort & Spa

$$$

≈16 km · ~20 min from the airport

Upscale AAA Four-Diamond condo-suites on the quiet Flamingos beach, with two well-kept pickleball courts and a big spa. All-inclusive is an optional add-on plan, and the suites — with kitchens and balconies — suit a longer, slower stay.

Current promotion: Black Friday & Cyber Days pre-sale: up to 45% off, free breakfast, kids stay free, free airport transfer.

Visit resort →

Puerto Vallarta Proper

Puerto Vallarta has the real downtown malecón — a paved seaside promenade, great for daily walks. Resorts here are 5–15 minutes from the airport.

Secrets Vallarta Bay

$$$$

≈6 km · ~10 min from the airport

Pickleball and shuffleboard, adults-only, 10–15 minutes from the malecón.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership), plus suite, cabana and spa extras on April stays. Book by Mon Nov 23.

Pickleball — confirm courts and equipment at booking, as guest reports vary — no shuffleboard, family resort, 10–15 minutes from the malecón and the airport.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership). Book by Mon Nov 23. The extra suite and spa perks don’t apply here.

Pickleball (8 courts) and shuffleboard, 5 minutes from the airport, 10 minutes from the malecón. Note: a local club uses the courts on weekday mornings, so afternoons are the safe bet.

Further afield

All a drive from the malecón — Garza Blanca and Barceló south of downtown, the Punta de Mita resorts up the coast, and Delta north near La Cruz.

Garza Blanca Preserve Resort & Spa

$$$$$

≈20 km · ~35 min from the airport

Outdoor pickleball and basketball courts, plus squash, at a luxury all-suite resort on a jungle hillside above a swimmable beach, south of downtown. All-inclusive is an add-on, not the default rate. No shuffleboard. Its adults-only sister hotel, Hotel Mousai, shares the same Preserve grounds.

Current promotion: Black Friday: every third night free, plus up to 50% off select rates. Book by Sun Nov 29.

Visit resort →

Secrets Bahia Mita Surf & Spa

$$$$$

≈37 km · ~40 min from the airport

3 pickleball courts shared with the adjoining Dreams Bahia Mita, adults-only, in Punta de Mita about 50 minutes from the airport. All-inclusive, with free-flow access to Dreams next door, including its shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership). Book by Mon Nov 23. The extra suite and spa perks don’t apply here.

Visit resort →

Barceló Puerto Vallarta

$$

≈25 km · ~45 min from the airport

Pickleball on the multi-sport court (portable nets — confirm paddles and nets at booking), family resort on Mismaloya Beach south of downtown, 4 pools, all suites, jungle mountains behind the beach, plus shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 55% off with code 26BF15. Book by Thu Dec 3; stays through Dec 30 — April is covered.

Visit resort →

Dreams Bahia Mita Surf & Spa Resort

$$$$

≈33 km · ~35 min from the airport

Family-friendly luxury on a surf beach at Punta de Mita, sharing three modern pickleball courts (plus shuffleboard) with its adults-only sister resort Secrets Bahia Mita. Water park, 363 suites, and 11 restaurants between the two resorts. Confirm paddles and balls at booking.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership). Book by Mon Nov 23 — a fallback offer runs to Tue Dec 8.

Visit resort →

Grand Palladium Vallarta Resort & Spa

$$

≈32 km · ~40 min from the airport

Big family all-inclusive on a jungle-backed cove at Punta de Mita, with two pickleball courts, a surf beach, kids’ water park and 24-hour all-inclusive dining. Best value of the Punta de Mita options. Bring your own paddles.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 50% off with code BFCM. Book by Sun Nov 29.

Visit resort →

Delta Hotels Riviera Nayarit

$$

≈24 km · ~30 min from the airport

Jungle-hillside all-inclusive near La Cruz with ten pools, a lazy river and a water park. Pickleball is informal — two painted lines on the tennis court with rolling nets and weekly beginner sessions — so bring paddles and treat it as a bonus, not the reason to book.

Visit resort →

Left off the list: Villa del Palmar in Puerto Vallarta — cheapest, but it’s mid-rebuild with amenities disappearing, so we’re skipping it.
